LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Pacifier_TIII.label: tenebral dread beacon
LanguageData.BOR_Turret_Pacifier_TIII.description: A tenebral pylon that bleeds a red field into its surroundings. Anyone who lingers inside feels it: a dark influence at first, a confusing mist after about 20 seconds, and a berserk rage after about a minute. Psychic sensitivity sets the pace, from immune at 0% to twice as fast at 200%. Tenebral psychotics and Umbrals are immune and Orientis resist half of it. It does not tell friend from foe.
